statement: Own global, passive and aura ordinary CSD descriptors and source-verified lookup formats. Additionally own each unique explicit no_description directive as an unrendered diagnostic only when it cannot erase a legacy single, compound or descriptor. The diagnostic is not an effectless law and never authorizes complete effect packets to omit a stat. All other unresolvable/ambiguous records remain explicitly bound compatibility. Source acquisition remains draft; no source or adoption approval is inferred.
